name: Kaminoyu
source:
The bath at my apartment building blew up, completely at random, without warning. This, to me… is a death sentence. Call me crazy – but I’d much rather go hungry than live without my Ofuro !!!… and so I got a recommendation from a friend and began to work at a bathhouse… only…

It’s a bathhouse for Gods!

At my job, bishoujos can turn into monsters… the small one turns into a violent onee-san and the brute girl turns into a shy girl… and then my friend who recommended me the job turns into a girl. The best part… they are all trying to blow up the bathhouse to prove their worth!! …Not to mention that guy workers do the job of washing female customers… where did my sanity just go?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140910165539/http://visualnovelaer.fuwanovel.org/2011/11/trial-release-kaminoyu-run-a-bathhouse-for-bishoujo-gods/]Aaeru's Blog[/url]]
translation:
我住的公寓浴室毫无征兆地突然爆炸。对我而言……这无异于死刑。说我疯也无所谓——相比失去浴室，我宁愿挨饿！！！于是，经朋友介绍，我开始到一家澡堂工作……然而……

这里竟是众神专用的澡堂！

工作时，美少女会变成怪物……娇小女孩会变成粗暴大姐姐，强悍女孩会变得腼腆……介绍我来工作的朋友甚至会变成女孩。最离谱的是……她们为了证明自己的价值，竟然全都想把澡堂炸掉！！……更别说男员工还要负责替女性顾客洗澡……我的理智究竟到哪里去了？

[译自 [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140910165539/http://visualnovelaer.fuwanovel.org/2011/11/trial-release-kaminoyu-run-a-bathhouse-for-bishoujo-gods/]Aaeru's Blog[/url]]
